title: Illumina DNA Prep - Tagment Genomic DNA
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input your protocol parameters for part 1/4 of the Illumina DNA Prep (Tagment Genomic DNA) in the OT App.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware files (JSON extensions) if needed.

steps.title: Upload Python protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the .py protocol file to the Protocol tab of the OT App.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App (see support articles for details).

steps.title: Perform manual plate actions
steps.instruction: Follow on‑screen prompts to move plates, perform manual centrifugation, seal plates, and run thermocycling steps as required.

steps.title: Start protocol run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the protocol.
